comments.author: George
comments.body:
I was getting boulders only at r5 and ranked up to 6 and started getting leaves also. Funny if I just wanted boulders it would be better to have a lower rank.
Be cool if they could alter this so that you could choose the target product you wanted to collect once you mastered the collection skill. Well not just you, when I say you, I mean everyone.

When I was a young boy, my mama had me go pick some blueberries. I used to come back with blueberries and boysenberries. When I turned a year older, I would come back with 90% blueberries and 10%... Well, you get the idea, but maybe not, so... I would come back with 90% blueberries and 10% boysenberries.

The next year I was able to come back with ALL blueberries and my mama was so proud that she would buy me a new bucket to put the blueberries in. I called it my blueberry bucket.
